_doc: Canonical hook WIRING manifest (Phase 2 of the harness-sync plan). Hook LOGIC lives beside this file (scripts/md payloads — the canon; per-harness copies are dead). harness-sync.sh renders this into each harness's dialect: the `hooks` key of <repos>/.claude/settings.json (Claude), <repos>/.codex/hooks.json (Codex), tools/droid/hooks.json → ~/.factory/hooks.json (Droid). Pi has no declarative hooks (TS extensions only) — skipped with a warning. Placeholders: {HOOKS} = this dir via $HOME/Repos path · {HOME} = $HOME literal · {PROJECT} = $CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR (claude only). Event names are shared verbatim by Claude/Codex/Droid — no mapping table needed since Gemini's decommission. Per-harness `command` objects express capability-gated content variants (e.g. delegation-reminder: Claude assumes the memory-injection hook + Task-tool stances; harnesses without those get the manual-recall variant). NOTE: regenerating Codex's hooks.json invalidates its trusted_hash — re-trust once via /hooks in the Codex TUI.

wiring._doc: Claude-only: emits Claude hook-JSON; script stays in .claude/hooks/. Other harnesses compensate via the manual-recall reminder below.
